bullets.content: [general] Change one factor per solve (one refinement or one size). Changing 3-4 factors at once (h + f7 size + two edges) gives a compare number you cannot attribute. Use compare early; do not waste solves on multi-change meshes.

[general] Meshing is deterministic: never re-solve a known recipe (exact repeat gave same 5155 nodes, 20.7%). A noise control needs a small perturbation (box edge moved 1 mm). Solve 2 should be a bold change (region size >=30%), not a 2% tweak.

[general] After solve 1 ALWAYS call view(kind=error) (REPEATED skip); list top 5 hotspots with local h vs requested size, and position vs box bounds. A box helps only if it encloses the hotspot ±3 mm. Before submit, compare(a,b) on two different solves.
[general] Use all 4 solves; compare candidates against the control; submit by estimated A/c. When two single-factor tests both pay, spend the last solve on their COMBINATION.
[general] Do not pick the cheapest solve when its field error is far above target. Compare estimated A/c; at 1.3x target error, a 40% DOF increase that cuts error 25% pays.

[general] REPEATED: never compare a solve with itself (compare(1,1)). Use compare(new, previous); <0.15 is remeshing noise. A solve changing the field only ~15% with +6% DOFs is not worth submitting: use bolder region-specific changes (>=30%).
[general] Order-1 sizing loop: if nodes >7500 multiply all sizes by (nodes/6500)^(1/3); same if <5500. mesh() is free, iterate 2-3 times before first solve. Check min_quality >=0.1 each call.

[general] After every mesh() compare node count with known recipe counts (5638, 5997, 6205, 6315, 6389, 6560, a2 g4=6794). If within 1%, change a size by >=10% or a target before solving: tying a peer node-for-node lost every bonus. A 1 mm box change gave an identical mesh.
[general] Change exactly one factor per solve and say which; a solve changing body box and dropping edge 40 was unattributable.

[general] Before choosing an experiment, check solver_setup/tool_use avoid-notes; if the outcome is recorded (e.g. order 1 locking), pick an untested factor. Spend solves on region-specific order-2 changes >=30%, never on P1.
[general] Below target, score ∝ 1/(e²·DOFs): +10% DOFs needs ≥5% relative error drop; -20% DOFs is worth up to 12% error rise. Coarse solve 3 (c 2.55) won rank 1 at 16% error.
[general] Never coarsen several factors in one solve (g2 solve 3 changed h, box, f2, edges, edge 3 together). Coarsen one at a time so the error map shows which factor cost accuracy.

[general] When a hotspot sits ~1 mm inside a wall next to a face (f16/f19, 0.4-0.9 mm away), face/edge refinement r0.005 does not reach it. Use a box enclosing hotspot ±3 mm, size <=0.65x local h, radius >=0.005.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] After solve 1, call view(kind=error, view=-z) and read top-5 hotspots (location, face, local h). Here they show error on the clamped bottom strip, not f7, saving solves 2-3.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Next call: mesh(h=0.01, order=2, refinements=[{box:[0.012,-0.015,-0.0081,0.031,0.015,-0.003],size:0.002,radius:0.002},{group:f7,size:0.0035,radius:0.006},{box:[0.01,-0.028,-0.003,0.027,0.012,0.0081],size:0.004,radius:0.004}]). Changes only h vs a9 recipe (h 0.008, 17.8k DOFs); aim fewer DOFs at ~8-9% field error.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Plan: 1) a9 recipe at h 0.008 baseline (17.8k DOFs). 2) Same at h 0.010. 3) h 0.012 only if quality.min>=0.1 and nodes < h0.010's (diversity). compare(1,2), compare(1,3); submit max estimated A/c.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Highlight a9: upper bore box [0.01,-0.028,-0.003,0.027,0.012,0.0081] size 0.004 r0.004 cut field error 11.3%->8.4%, covering upper f5/f13 wall (#6 hotspot at h 0.0063). Shrinking bottom box further paid less per DOF.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] From a13 (field 10.1%, best accuracy): full-thickness box x 0.012-0.031 plus {edge:22, size 0.002, radius 0.006}. Bottom-only box is cheaper, but edge 22 at 0.002 merits a later single-factor test.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Box radius 0.001 does not deliver requested size (0.0028 gave h 0.0033-0.0037; a9's 0.002 r0.002 gave 0.0025). Use radius >= box size (0.002-0.003), never 0.001. Radius 0.005 test is optional single-factor.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Old finding: ~48% of error energy at z -0.0069..-0.0073 along f12 clamp boundary near f5 x 0.018-0.020 and f7 x 0.025-0.027. Upper bore box fixed part of it; check remaining hotspots.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Uncovered hotspot: +y bore end near f8 (0.0226,0.020,-0.005), 13.5% VM error at h 0.0053; bottom box stops y=0.015. Separate experiment: extend ymax to 0.024 or box y 0.015-0.03, z -0.008..-0.003, size 0.004.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hotspots on f5 (z≈-0.007, x 0.019-0.020) and f7 (y ±0.005) hold ~40% error energy at h~0.0035. Cell (0.0152,0.00142,-0.006) holds 12.6% with few elements: test {group f5, size 0.003, radius 0.004} instead of shrinking box.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Cell (0.0152,-0.0115,0.006) has 51% local error at h 0.0069 (f13/f52). Try f13 size 0.005 r0.004. Worst hidden point near f5 at y -0.0245 is coarse (0.0087).
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Coarsest regions (f6, f52, 1.5x median h) hold a hidden check point with 11.5% error near f5. A moderate refinement of f5/f6 (size 0.004) may help hidden points.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Order 2. Node count floors ~4400-4700 and is non-monotonic in h (h 0.014: 6795 nodes vs 0.010: 5535; h 0.009 > 0.008). Read nodes before solving an h variant; skip if DOFs do not drop vs 17796.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Check quality.min after each mesh (0.119 at h 0.008). Stacked boxes at coarse h failed (h 0.012 gave 0.037). If h 0.010/0.012 gives <0.1, step h back 0.001, keep sizes unchanged.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Old control (h 0.008, bottom box 0.0032 r0.001, f7 0.003 r0.006): base 0.639, field 12.3%. Superseded by a9 recipe; box 0.0028 gave 11.3%, score 0.672, +5.8% DOFs.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Setup verified: fixed f12, pressure 2.1e6 Pa on f7, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, 3D. Keep unchanged; still check reaction total against applied load.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Setup verified: 3d, fixed f12, pressure 2.1e6 on f7, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3. Reuse verbatim; all solves go to mesh experiments.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Pick by error per DOF: 1.4x DOFs must cut error ~19% to tie; +5.8% DOFs for -8% error is worth it. Above target score=g/(2c): 17.8k->~15k DOFs at same 8.4% error lifts base ~0.71->~0.85. Variant pays if compare change <3%.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Field error binds (a9 8.4% vs points 8.0%, nearly balanced). Below ~8% check-point RMS may bind; watch disclosed point near (0.0217,-0.0209) at f9/f13.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Order 1 settled: P1 gave 0.0220 J at 17.6k DOFs, 0.0226 J at 23.9k (locking) vs P2 ~0.0331 J. Never spend a solve on P1 here; order 2 only.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Pay line: refinement pays if energy gain % >= 0.075 x DOF increase %. From free baseline 0.03307 J at 16.9k DOFs, +20% DOFs needs >=0.03357 J. a5 rim+saddle 0.03339 J at 20.9k narrowly failed.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Playbook rim recipe (h 0.012, body 0.0054, f2 0.0025, rim boxes 0.003): 5638 nodes, 0.03307 J, field 20.2%, points 13.7%, tied a15 and paid nothing. Never submit unchanged or re-solve; small rim boxes alone are not the lever.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Control recipe (rank 1, base 0.233/score 0.327): h 0.012, order 2, body box [-0.021,-0.02,0,0.021,0.02,0.0575] 0.0058 r0.008, f2 0.003 r0.005, edges 39/8 0.0025, edge 40 0.003 (r0.005). 15465 DOFs, field 20.7%, points 9.9%. Safe fallback and cost anchor.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Best base (a8, 0.247): control plus flank boxes [0.009,-0.017,0.019,0.023,0.017,0.033] and mirror at 0.0035 r0.005, ~19k DOFs, field ~18%. But flanks cost 3.5k DOFs and score ranked 6: keep only if upper wall box doesn't stack DOFs; else relax body box to 0.0065.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Body-box ladder on a8-g3: 0.0066 ->17.9k, 0.03281 J; 0.0058 ->18.9k, 0.03335 J (field 18.1%); 0.005 without edge 40 ->20.2k, 0.03341 J, 15% stress change, no clear gain. Keep 0.0054-0.0058 in order 2.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Order-2 recipes saturate at 17-19% field for 18-22k DOFs. a1 (no edges, body 0.0048, f2 0.0022, rim boxes) 17.2% at 21.8k; a1 wide flank boxes [0.009..0.023,|y|<=0.016,z 0.019-0.033] put corners at 2.5-2.9%, field 17.9% at 19.9k: |y| coverage to 0.016-0.018 is the lever.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 39/8 at 0.002 vs 0.0025 added only 112 nodes, f16 still h 0.0054, compare 0.088 = noise. Edge size is not the lever for f16/f19 rim hotspots; volume boxes are.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] After each mesh call read 'element size near each group': f16 and f19 h must be ≤0.0045. In g2 f16 was 0.00608 (1.2x median) and went unnoticed before solving.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edge 40/3 at 0.0028 added 3.1k DOFs (+16%) with compare 0.16, about remeshing noise. Do not add edge 3; keep edge 40 at most 0.003 as in control.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction/saddle band z~0.0255: corner cells (±0.0174, ±0.0129) hold 14% at 23-26 elements, 170-250% local error, h~0.005; saddle (±0.013,±0.010,z 0.026) h 0.0055. Rim boxes |y|<=0.01 miss them: use quadrant boxes |y| to 0.018 at 0.0032 r0.005.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Error diffuse z 0.022-0.036 around f19,f16,f13,f20 at h~0.0055. Try one body-wide box [-0.021,-0.02,0.018,0.021,0.02,0.04] size 0.0042 r0.006 with rest of body relaxed to 0.0065.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Coarsening h 0.011/box 0.0045 (19.8k DOFs) to h 0.012/box 0.0058 (15.5k) gave field 20.7%, 17% stress difference. Try box 0.005 as single factor.
